# horde engine: parameters, for agents

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_agent_reference.py from docs/design/gui3/params.json and SPEC-ENGINE PA-8. Do not edit; edit the spec, regenerate params.json, then run the generator. -->

Every parameter of SPEC-ENGINE section 5, the engine as built today. Read `README.md` first for the patch format.

- **Keys.** `oscN.` is `osc1.` or `osc2.`; `bladeB.` is `blade1.` or `blade2.`; `envE.` is `env2.`, `env3.` or `env4.`. Every folded row exists for each copy. `oscN.blade2.` rows exist on blade 2 only.
- **Value.** Give x in the values column's numbers (a `%` row with range 0..1 takes 0..1). A step row takes one of its option names, or its 0-based index; a step row whose options are numbers takes the number.
- **Law.** How the host's v in [0, 1] maps to x (5.1). `tools/patch_check.py --set` converts for you.
- **Live when.** PA-8's own words. A row whose condition fails in your patch is inert: it changes nothing.
- **Status.** `built`: in the engine today. `reserved`: holds a key for a later feature and is refused in 1.0 (5.1, PA-7); never set it.

330 parameters in 169 rows below; 13 reserved; 2 with no description in the spec.

PA-8's preamble, verbatim: a parameter not listed is live whenever its source is on; `phase` and `phaseRandom` are live at every `retrigger` setting, since a start with nothing to resume uses them.

The smooth square is appended last, so it moves no index; the removal of the noise wave moved bump from index 6 to 5, harmless in a manifest not yet released. A panel may show the smooth square after the square. ## The noise oscillator (5.6)

- PA-8, *every noise row but `spread`, `pan`, `mute`, `solo` and `env`*: the noise is on, or the sub is on with `erode` > 0 (Erode reads the noise's left channel before its envelope, level and pan, SN-14)
- `spread`, `pan`, `mute`, `solo` and `env` are live only while `noise.on` is on.

| key | unit | values | law | default | what it does (section 5) | live when (PA-8) | status |
